HGTECH.why: Makes 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers for AI data centers (Thailand and Wuhan capacity, 800G LPO in volume at a North American customer); its stock benefits directly from optical interconnect demand.
HGTECH.evidence: HGTECH investor Q&A (09-22-2026): Thailand phase-1 monthly capacity 20 ten-thousand units (1.6T ~2, 800G ~18 ten-thousand); Wuhan to reach 800G 80-100 ten-thousand and 1.6T 20 ten-thousand per month by year-end.

players.product: 800G / 1.6T optical transceivers (incl. 800G LPO) on in-house silicon photonics chips; 3.2T / 6.4T NPO engines in customer testing

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: NPO has advantages over CPO in yield, first-pass rate, overall cost-performance and test efficiency, so it expects NPO to develop faster; with industry-chain partners it was first to develop 100G/lane and 200G/lane 3.2T/6.4T NPO products, now in testing at leading domestic and overseas AI companies.

quarterly_data.quarter: HGTECH investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its high-end transceivers were at sampling/certification and small-batch stage overseas last year and reached small-batch and volume shipments in Q1 this year, so overseas growth is large off a small base; it has launched 800G ACC and 1.6T AEC/ACC copper cable modules.
